name: ballerina/websubhub
description: This module provides APIs for a WebSub Hub service and WebSub Publisher client.

outbound request/response accept-encoding/content-encoding option.

typeDefs.name: Compression
typeDefs.description:
Options to compress using Gzip or deflate.

`AUTO`: When service behaves as a HTTP gateway inbound request/response accept-encoding option is set as the
outbound request/response accept-encoding/content-encoding option
`ALWAYS`: Always set accept-encoding/content-encoding in outbound request/response
`NEVER`: Never set accept-encoding/content-encoding header in outbound request/response

functions.name: markAsVerified

parameters.name: subscription
parameters.description: The `websubhub:Subscription` or `websubhub:Unsubscription` message

return.description:
A `websubhub:Error` if the `websubhub:Service` has not enabled subscription auto-verification,

typeDefs.name: Listener
typeDefs.description:
Initiliazes the `websubhub:Listener` instance.
```ballerina
listener websubhub:Listener hubListenerEp = check new (9090);
```

functions.name: init
functions.description:
Initiliazes the `websubhub:Listener` instance.
```ballerina
listener websubhub:Listener hubListenerEp = check new (9090);
```

parameters.name: listenTo
parameters.description: Port number or an `http:Listener` instance

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The host name/IP of the endpoint

parameters.name: http1Settings
parameters.description: Configurations related to HTTP/1.x protocol

parameters.name: secureSocket
parameters.description:
The SSL configurations for the service endpoint. This needs to be configured in order to
communicate through HTTPS.

parameters.name: httpVersion
parameters.description: Highest HTTP version supported by the endpoint

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description:
Period of time in seconds that a connection waits for a read/write operation. Use value 0 to
disable timeout

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: The server name which should appear as a response header

parameters.name: requestLimits
parameters.description: Configurations associated with inbound request size limits

parameters.name: gracefulStopTimeout
parameters.description: Grace period of time in seconds for listener gracefulStop

parameters.name: socketConfig
parameters.description: Provides settings related to server socket configuration

parameters.name: http2InitialWindowSize
parameters.description: Configuration to change the initial window size in HTTP/2

parameters.name: minIdleTimeInStaleState
parameters.description:
Minimum time in seconds for a connection to be kept open which has received a GOAWAY.
This only applies for HTTP/2. Default value is 5 minutes. If the value is set to -1,
the connection will be closed after all in-flight streams are completed

parameters.name: timeBetweenStaleEviction
parameters.description:
Time between the connection stale eviction runs in seconds. This only applies for HTTP/2.
Default value is 30 seconds

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Custom `websubhub:ListenerConfiguration` to be provided to the underlying HTTP listener

return.description: The `websubhub:Listener` or an `websubhub:Error` if the initialization failed

functions.name: attach
functions.description:
Attaches the provided `websubhub:Service` to the `websubhub:Listener`.
```ballerina
check hubListenerEp.attach('service, "/hub");
```

parameters.name: 'service
parameters.description: The `websubhub:Service` object to attach

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The path of the service to be hosted

return.description: An `websubhub:Error` if an error occurred during the service attaching process or else `()`

functions.name: detach
functions.description:
Detaches the provided `websubhub:Service` from the `websubhub:Listener`.
```ballerina
check hubListenerEp.detach('service);
```

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: The `websubhub:Service` object to be detached

return.description: An `websubhub:Error` if an error occurred during the service detaching process or else `()`

functions.name: 'start
functions.description:
Starts the registered service programmatically.
```ballerina
check hubListenerEp.'start();
```

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description:
Gracefully stops the hub listener. Already-accepted requests will be served before the connection closure.
```ballerina
check hubListenerEp.gracefulStop();
```

return.description: An `websubhub:Error` if an error occurred during the listener-stopping process

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description:
Stops the service listener immediately.
```ballerina
check hubListenerEp.immediateStop();
```

return.description: An `websubhub:Error` if an error occurred during the listener-stopping process or else `()`

functions.name: notifyContentDistribution
functions.description:
Distributes the published content to the subscribers.
```ballerina
ContentDistributionSuccess publishUpdate = check websubHubClientEP->notifyContentDistribution({ content: "This is sample content" });
```

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Content to be distributed to the topic subscriber

return.description:
An `websubhub:Error` if an exception occurred, a `websubhub:SubscriptionDeletedError` if the subscriber responded with `HTTP 410`,
or else a `websubhub:ContentDistributionSuccess` for successful content delivery

functions.name: registerTopic
functions.description:
Registers a topic in a Ballerina WebSub Hub to which the subscribers can subscribe and the publisher will publish updates.
```ballerina
websubhub:TopicRegistrationSuccess response = check publisherClient->registerTopic("http://websubpubtopic.com");
```

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The topic to register

return.description: A `websubhub:TopicRegistrationError` if an error occurred registering the topic or else `websubhub:TopicRegistrationSuccess`

functions.name: deregisterTopic
functions.description:
Deregisters a topic in a Ballerina WebSub Hub.
```ballerina
websubhub:TopicDeregistrationSuccess response = check publisherClient->deregisterTopic("http://websubpubtopic.com");
```

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The topic to deregister

return.description: A `websubhub:TopicDeregistrationError` if an error occurred un registering the topic or else `websubhub:TopicDeregistrationSuccess`

functions.name: publishUpdate
functions.description:
Publishes an update to a remote Ballerina WebSub Hub.
```ballerina
websubhub:Acknowledgement response = check publisherClient->publishUpdate("http://websubpubtopic.com",{"action": "publish",
"mode": "remote-hub"});
```

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The topic for which the update occurred

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: The update payload

parameters.name: contentType
parameters.description: The type of the update content to set as the `ContentType` header

return.description: A `websubhub:UpdateMessageError`if an error occurred with the update or else `websubhub:Acknowledgement`

functions.name: notifyUpdate
functions.description:
Notifies a remote WebSubHub from which an update is available to fetch for hubs that require publishing.
```ballerina
 websubhub:Acknowledgement|websubhub:UpdateMessageError response = check publisherClient->notifyUpdate("http://websubpubtopic.com");
```

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The topic for which the update occurred

return.description: A `websubhub:UpdateMessageError` if an error occurred with the notification or else `websubhub:Acknowledgement`
